title: TELANGANA STATE POLICE RECRUITMENT
summary: As per our announcement dated 17th September 2026, the Preliminary Written Test of the recruitment process of 275  SCT SI Civil and / or equivalent posts concerning the Notification issued on 29th July 2026 will be held on 29th November 2026 (Sunday) from 10 am to 1 pm for 1,60,712 Candidates in nearly 335 Test Centers across the State.
